mission: Test whether one durable Agent Run can preserve identity, commitments, evidence and exact admitted authority across a real Harness implementation upgrade that adds new installed capabilities, without resetting all state or silently inheriting all newly installed mechanisms.
questionOrHypothesis: Is invariant-bound continuity a better operational identity model than byte/revision sameness, reset-all migration, or inherit-all-installed migration?
naturalChange: Between revisions Harness added exact reusable cross-Run procedural cognition admission and bounded ToolProgram composition while preserving the installed != Run-admitted != turn-admitted capability law.
startingState: A real no-Tool HarnessAgentRun is created under the old revision, reaches needs_input, and leaves one healthy durable paused Run in a shared state root. No Provider or Runtime Tool is used.
candidateIdentityModel: INVARIANT_BOUND: reopen the exact old durable state under current code; preserve Run identity, Contract/object digests, admitted Tool catalog/grant, history and uncertainty; allow current implementation to understand old state but do not infer newly installed action authority. New mechanisms require separate explicit admission.

countermodels.prediction: implementation change invalidates prior Run identity/state and requires a fresh Run or semantic reconstruction
new package-installed P1/P2 mechanisms automatically become current capability/authority of the old Run
the system is the same only if implementation bytes/revision remain unchanged

predeclaredGates: old paused state is healthy before upgrade
current revision reopens exact old Run without rewriting its Contract identity
Run ID and Contract digest remain exact
current package-level catalog exposes post-old-revision mechanisms
old Run projection does not acquire ToolProgram from package installation
resumed exact turn does not acquire ToolProgram or physical Tools
same Run can continue to candidate_completed under current implementation
invalidityConditions: editing the old Contract before reopen
rebuilding old state with current code instead of opening old-written bytes
using a new Run ID and calling that continuity
treating package installation as explicit authority admission
changing the old Tool catalog/grant digests
using external Provider success as the identity oracle
authorityBoundary: Research-only Harness state under /tmp plus read-only current Harness source. No Harness owner mutation, no external Provider call, no Runtime Tool effect.
promotionBoundary: One Harness P0->P2 migration can support a scoped identity-under-change Knowledge candidate. It cannot establish a universal constitution, global migration object, or cross-owner identity service.
